140450101.text: ...Mesdames et Messieurs! Welcome, one and all, to the Hotel Debord and to this most exciting of cooking contests!

140450102.text: Savanna, I've brought the original copy of the Codex you asked for.

140450105.text: In the interests of fairness, this contest will be conducted in a double-blind format. Once the dishes are complete, they will be sent to the back of the kitchen, where they'll each receive a label.

140450106.text: The labels will be placed out of sight underneath the plates, only to be revealed after the judges have sampled them and reached a final verdict. This is to ensure that no one will know which dish is made by which contestant.

140450107.text: ...As one of the judges, I promise to be fair and impartial.

140450108.text: Heh, when my meal got interrupted yesterday, I never thought this is how they'd make it up to me! Getting a seat on the judging panel is a pretty sweet deal!

140450109.text: Both contestants have taken their positions. Then, without further ado: Let the Hotel Debord cooking contest... commence!

subQuests.subQuestName: Make the first tier of cake

140450401.text: Time's up! Contestants, please take your dishes to the back.

140450402.text: Huh... That guy was right. You really can't tell whose is whose just by looking at them.

140450403.text: We both made the same dish, after all. For all her flaws, Savanna's a talented chef who earned my recommendation for good reason. She wouldn't screw up something as elementary as the cake's appearance.

140450404.text: Whoa! This is really rather good!

140450405.text: Wonderfully soft and fluffy, beautifully sweet... This is a masterclass in how to make Gateau Debord!

140450407.text: I would give this one at least... nine point nine out of ten!

140450408.text: Only because there's something about the flavor of the base... It's just a little different from the recipe I'm used to...

140450411.text: Haha, alright — onto gateau number two! ...Mmm... I haven't had a single bite, and already this aroma is a delight to the senses!

140450412.text: I have a feeling that this gateau will be a gateau for the ages!

140450416.text: Uhh... I think, maybe... someone got a little carried away when they were adding the sugar?

140450417.text: Not just the sugar — it's the flavors too. This is all over the place... Who made this!?

140450418.text: *sigh*... It appears the decision is unanimous. This gateau is far below the standard we would expect.

140450419.text: Phew... And Paimon thought this might actually be close. Turns out, she can't bake to save her life!

140450422.text: ...Something's not right here. Savanna may not be perfect, but no way is she this sloppy...

140450423.text: I can now declare that the creator of the first gateau has won this cooking contest. Now, all that remains is to turn the plate over, and reveal the chef's name underneath...

140450427.text: Hey! Savanna! You cheated, didn't you? You cheater!

140450428.text: What did you do? ...Oh, you swapped the plates, didn't you!

140450429.text: Well, someone's a sore loser. These cakes went from the oven to the judges' table without me ever laying a finger on them, and everyone here can attest to that.

140450430.text: It was Vaneigem's staff who labelled them in the kitchen. If you're looking to accuse someone, why don't you start with them?

140450431.text: Isn't it more likely that Escoffier's lost her edge? Oh, or maybe her assistants let the team down?

140450435.text: That's enough... What's done is done.

140450436.text: As head chef... or rather, as team lead, I take responsibility for the dish I served. Whatever went wrong, and however it happened, I should have spotted it.

140450437.text: Savanna... I didn't think you'd stoop this low just to beat me in a bake-off... What happened to your chef's pride?

140450438.text: I... I don't know what you're talking about!

140450439.text: If you want the Codex Debord that much, you can have it.

140450441.text: But you must promise me that you'll apologize to Firmin, and compensate him for everything you put him through!

140450442.text: It's a little late to be negotiating terms... The contest is over, and I won. That means you owe me the Codex, and I owe you nothing!

140450443.text: Look, Savanna, you may have fooled everyone else, but can you really fool yourself? What I'm offering is to accept defeat without looking to expose what you've done...

140450445.text: ...But only on the condition that you promise to stop putting so much pressure on your staff.

140450446.text: ...Hmph, fine. I'll treat this as your final handover of duties from one head chef to the next.

140450447.text: So will that be all, ex-head chef? Or is there any other unfinished business you'd like to leave in my hands?

140450448.text: I didn't mean that to be a scolding from your former boss. Just a word of advice from a fellow chef... and a friend.

140450449.text: But I don't know if you're even open to input from other people anymore.

140450450.text: I know what I'm doing... I don't need your advice!

140450451.text: Alright, fine. I'm glad to hear it.

140450453.text: The Codex Debord! Finally! Now, at long last, I will succeed!

140450454.text: Escoffier! How could you let her get away with this?

140450455.text: Yeah! The Codex is a souvenir of your time here... Doesn't that mean anything to you?

140450456.text: ...It's alright. It was just a bake-off, not the end of the world. I'm already over it.

140450457.text: Besides, it's not all bad — she agreed to compensate Firmin. That's mission accomplished for the Spina.

140450458.text: Honestly, if I'd known that giving her the Codex would solve everything, I'd have just done that in the first place. I mean, why bother with a whole cooking contest? It's such a waste of time and energy!

140450601.text: ...Well, how is it? Have you figured out what it was?

140450602.text: ...Ugh, this is aggravated assault on my palate! I'd rather eat wet cement than this!

140450603.text: Uh, i—is it really that bad? I made sure to taste-test it before it was served...

140450604.text: Relax, this isn't your cake. Savanna never switched the plates.

140450605.text: The offending flavors are coming from in between the icing and the cake base... Which means, someone tampered with it while it was being made.

140450606.text: Or in other words... we have a traitor in our midst.

140450607.text: ...I'm sorry! I—I was forced into it!

140450608.text: It was Chef Savanna! She said... if I didn't cooperate, she would... she would...

140450609.text: Calm down, Monica! I've already accepted defeat, and if I wanted retribution, I would have brought this up when the results were announced.

140450610.text: Whatever's going on with you, just spill the beans. There's no need to hide it.

140450612.text: *sigh*... I was the one who caused the food safety incident that one time.

140450613.text: Food safety... Wait, you mean the lumiline incident!? So YOU procured the contaminated ingredients?

140450614.text: I—I think so... Savanna and I were on procurement that day. I didn't check everything as well as I should have, and so... I let contaminated ingredients make it into the kitchen...

140450615.text: But I swear, I didn't do it on purpose! I had no idea there was an issue with them, and I didn't know it would end up with Escoffier going to jail!

140450616.text: ...But the last thing I expected was for Savanna to use it as leverage to blackmail me with...

140450617.text: This is crazy... So, Savanna pressured you into sabotaging Escoffier's cake by threatening to expose your secret if you didn't?

140450618.text: I know, it's terrible... I'm so sorry! I just... I was so scared! The thought of Chef Escoffier finding out that I put her in jail... it made me freeze up with fear...

140450619.text: I thought Escoffier would hate my guts if she ever found out... And yet somehow, that's ended up in me doing something even worse! I... I... *sob*

140450620.text: Seriously... All this fuss over a little slip-up?

140450622.text: Firstly, it's not like I got a life sentence. I did my stint at the Fortress, and now I'm out. Secondly... I had my own reasons for leaving the Hotel Debord, this wasn't the only factor.

140450623.text: So you don't need to feel ashamed, or frightened, or anything like that — any more than you need to add butter when you're pan searing foie gras.

140450625.text: Oh... Well, I'm not saying you don't have to take responsibility for your mistakes.

140450626.text: You should tell Vaneigem to mark down your performance for the past few months, then do some digging and find out exactly where those contaminated ingredients came from. Sure, you've made mistakes, but now's the time to fix them. Understood?

140450628.text: Good. Now, back to Savanna... What about the original Codex would compel her to resort to blackmail?

140450629.text: Um... I have my suspicions, not that I've got any proof to back them up though...

140450631.text: I've overheard some customers murmuring about how the Hotel Debord hasn't been the same since Escoffier left. They think our menu doesn't taste like it used to... especially our signature items.

140450633.text: Now that you mention it... I noticed it during the contest, too. I couldn't put my finger on it, but the flavor seemed subtly different from how it used to be...

140450634.text: ...But the difference was so small, I'm sure no one would notice it besides our most loyal customers and true dessert connoisseurs.

140450635.text: Still, as head chef, it's easy to see why Savanna would get so hung up on it.

140450636.text: So many times, I've seen her make the cake base over and over again, late into the night, determined to match Escoffier's version. But something's always slightly off every time...

140450637.text: Yeah, I've noticed that, too... Never really gave it much thought, though.

140450638.text: Thinking back on it now... it's clear that Savanna's been in a downward spiral ever since Escoffier left.

140450639.text: She wants to prove that she can fill Escoffier's shoes. That's gotta be the reason.

140450640.text: But after countless setbacks, she's getting more and more unhinged.

140450641.text: And at some point along the way, she switched from doubting herself... to doubting Escoffier.

140450643.text: ...She thought the Codex from Escoffier was a fake.

140450644.text: Yeah, it would explain why she was bent on getting the original at any cost. She must have thought Escoffier purposely omitted key details from her recipes when she copied them out...

140450645.text: All so she could retain her place as the number one chef in Fontaine... the only one privy to all the secrets of the trade.

140450646.text: Oh for goodness' sake! What a stupid idea!

140450647.text: Of course, then she finally got the Codex, only to discover that the secret recipes she's been pining for don't exist at all...

140450648.text: Seeing how utterly wrong she was must have been a real shock to the system. It probably brought up everything at once, it overwhelmed her, and she passed out.

140450650.text: There's still one thing that doesn't make sense, though... If Savanna had the real recipe all along, how come it tasted different?

140450651.text: She might not be on the same level as Escoffier, but surely after, like, fifty attempts, she'd get it right one of those times?

140450652.text: You'd think so, but... geniuses like Escoffier are in a league of their own.

140450656.text: "...She's keeping the true recipe to herself..."

140450657.text: ...New head chef, you say? What's her name? ...Hmm, I don't think I've heard of her before...

140450658.text: ...I wonder, can the Hotel Debord keep its edge without Escoffier at the helm?

140450659.text: This tastes different from last time... Is it undercooked, or something?

140450661.text: "...Get your hands on the Codex... no matter what it takes!"

140450662.text: Take this. It's a copy of the Codex Debord. From now on, you will be its keeper.

140450663.text: Don't listen to the doubters. If I say you can do it, then you can do it! Even if you don't believe in yourself, at least believe in me.

140450664.text: Hey! Did you hear me? ...Once I'm gone, the restaurant is all yours.

140450665.text: "...So YOU let the lumiline into the kitchen?"

140450666.text: All this time, I've been blaming other people, but maybe... I'm the problem...

140450667.text: ...I sincerely apologize for putting everyone out. Savanna's awake now, but... I don't think she's ready to speak to anyone yet.

140450668.text: Let's give her the day to calm down. I'm sure you'll have the chance to talk everything out tomorrow.

140450669.text: In that case, I'll go and update Firmin and his family. I wonder what he'll make of all this...

140450672.text: Phew... That was a long day. I think I've earned myself a sweet treat when I get back home...

140450673.text: Ooh, nice. Macarons? Or are you gonna switch it up this time?

140450677.text: #...{NICKNAME}, how much do you know about the Snow-Winged Goose?

140441701.text: ...Let's hope that Savanna isn't all sizzle and no steak. After all the work we've put in... it would kinda be a shame if tomorrow was a complete cakewalk.

140450301.text: The Strongest Chef of Today vs. The Strongest Chef in History! A legendary contest of mastery over Hotel Debord's legendary dish, the Gateau Debord, is about to commence! The prize — custodianship over the Codex Debord!

140459901.text: It's cooking contest day! To the Hotel Debord, tout suite!

140459902.text: Did you hear the news? Escoffier's coming back for a cooking contest!

140459903.text: Wait, seriously? Escoffier, in a cooking contest? Now that, I've got to see!

140459904.text: I don't get it... Why would anyone in their right mind challenge her to a cooking contest?

140459905.text: #Monica, {NICKNAME}, it's go time. Let's do this!

140459906.text: Alphonse, Gaspard, get to work! Do not disappoint me!

140459907.text: Haha! Looks like our two head chefs are raring to go! Like an oven on full blast, this competition is quickly heating up...

140459909.text: Alphonse! What are you playing at!? That's not how I taught you to do it! Stop horsing around, and do it again!

140459911.text: Ooh... Tension in the ranks on team Savanna... Will this slow their progress?

140459912.text: (For goodness' sake, Savanna, what are you doing? ...Ugh, forget it. I've gotta focus on my own dish...)

140459913.text: Escoffier is already on the final step of the recipe! Let's check on Savanna's progress...

140459914.text: Hmm... I think this flavor profile is still a little bit off!

140459915.text: Enough! Ugh, useless... Both of you, make like an egg and beat it! I'll do it myself!

140459916.text: Wow! Is Savanna serious? Can she really make up for lost time working alone?

140459917.text: ...Even the best chef in the world can't flavor their food without prepping the flavoring, right?
